names.note: The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru’s name page 1115, «Исидор Римский, мч.», with the rank word after the comma left off. The day line gives the bare forename in the genitive, «Исидора». `fk.mjs` returns no holder for «исидор римскии»; the corpus’s eleven other Isidore folders are of Chios, Pelusium, Seville, Cordoba, Antioch, Rostov, Samtavisi, Vali and three bare days, none of them on this one.

death.note: The year the day line closes with for the whole company, «(301)», and the year the reading sets after the nine names it beheads, «( 301)». It is the same year the eight companion folders the corpus already keeps carry off saint.gr. No year of birth is given, and nothing is said of his age.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 6 июля ст. ст. — «Мц. Лукии девы и с нею мчч. Рикса , Антония , Лукиана , Исидора , Диона , Диодора , Кутония , Ароноса (Ориона), Капика и Сатура (301).»

attestations.note: The day’s fifth entry, fourth name, and the ONE NAME OF ITS ELEVEN THE CORPUS DID NOT ALREADY HOLD. ELEVEN NAMES ON THE RUSSIAN LINE AGAINST FIFTEEN ON THE GREEK, AND THE TWO LISTS ARE READ AGAINST EACH OTHER NAME BY NAME. The corpus already keeps this company off saint.gr’s «Άγιοι Εικοσιτέσσερις Μάρτυρες» of the same menologion 6/7 and the same year 301, which enumerates fifteen and then says «και άλλοι εννέα», and nine others. The Russian line names Lucia, Rix and nine more. Eight of those nine answer to a Greek name of the fifteen and take that folder’s russian row; the ninth, Исидор, is a name the Greek list does not print and is a new folder, `isidore-companion-of-lucia`. The alignment is positional as well as onomastic: Greek «… Κοττύιος. Όρωνος, Παπικός, Σάτυρος» against Russian «… Кутония , Ароноса (Ориона), Капика и Сатура» is four consecutive names in the same order. The seven Greek names the Russian line does NOT print — Ανατολίας, Άπαμος, Απολλώνιος, Νέας, Παππιανός, Σερίνος, Βίκτωρ — keep their undocumented russian rows and were left exactly as they stand. `dates` UNCHANGED: this line’s 301 is the year the folder already carries. The reading life4169 was opened; it is one account for the whole company and names the nine only in the closing sentence. No hymn on the day page stands under any of these names. He is therefore not given the epithet «one of the Twenty-four Martyrs» the eight companion folders carry, because that company and its number are saint.gr’s and saint.gr does not name him: the display name takes the Russian line’s own frame instead, «и с нею», with her. No life of his own exists; the reading life4169 is the company’s and names him once. azbyka.ru was not read.
